description.text: The Japanese Gym deck of Misty, Cerulean City's Gym Leader, sold as ポケモンジム第1弾「ハナダシティジム カスミ」 (Pokémon Gym 1: Hanada City Gym, Kasumi) on 26 April 1998 with Brock's deck, the first two of six. Its 64 cards are 24 different ones: Misty's own Pokémon, Misty as a holo Trainer, a holo Misty's Tentacruel, the Cerulean City Gym stadium, new Trainers, and reworded copies of older Trainers that the decks share. The cards carry the Gym series' symbol, as Leader's Stadium's and Challenge from the Darkness's do, but no card number or rarity mark. Leader's Stadium reprinted many of them with a rarity mark, and English players got them in Gym Heroes; the deck was the model for the English Misty theme deck. Its fixed rarities made Misty's Goldeen and Tentacool two of Gym Heroes' "common rares" when the cards came to English. It came with a rule book, counters and a blue Starmie coin.
